title: Card Authorization & Reconciliation Lab walkthrough
format: Silent edited screenshots of the recorded-evidence viewer, with open captions and a WebVTT track. Not continuous live execution.

scenes.title: Card Authorization & Reconciliation Lab
scenes.caption: A guided look at recorded PostgreSQL tests. Synthetic funds; no live backend.

scenes.title: 01 / Capture creates an obligation
scenes.caption: 100 authorized. A partial capture makes 60 payable and leaves 40 held.

scenes.title: Expiry releases the remaining hold
scenes.caption: 40 returns to available capacity. The 60 already payable stays payable.

scenes.title: A valid late clearing still posts
scenes.caption: The remaining 40 clears after expiry. Payable reaches 100; the journal explains why.

scenes.title: Reusing released capacity can create exposure
scenes.caption: In this variant, a later purchase uses capacity. Late clearing exposes a 30-unit shortfall.

scenes.title: 02 / A lost response leaves uncertainty
scenes.caption: The process dies after commit. The app keeps the hold until authoritative evidence arrives.

scenes.title: Recovery releases the reservation once
scenes.caption: The processor decline resolves uncertainty. Replaying recovery adds no financial effect.

scenes.title: 03 / Equal totals can hide different transactions
scenes.caption: This deliberate identity-substitution fixture totals 100 on both sides, yet two rows differ.

scenes.title: Inspect the guarantees and their limits
scenes.caption: Explore the architecture, crash tests and measured limits, including recovery backlog.
